[[Category:Symington Churchyard, Symington, South Lanarkshire]]
== Biography ==
William was born in 1783.  He passed away in 1873.
== Research Notes ==
=== Possible Biggar memorial, 1873 ===

A Findmypast Scotland Monumental Inscriptions transcript records William Glasgow, aged 89, death year 1873, at St Johns Kirk, Biggar, Lanarkshire. The indexed birth year of 1784 appears to derive from the age and death year; it is not an exact birthday. No exact death date is supplied.<ref>Findmypast, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBPRS%2FSCOT%2FMIS%2F204969 Scotland Monumental Inscriptions, William Glasgow, GBPRS/SCOT/MIS/204969, St Johns Kirk, Biggar, Lanarkshire]; provider derivative transcript inspected 4 November 2026; original record or gravestone image uninspected.</ref>

William’s uncertain 1783 birth and recorded death on 25 December 1873 are compatible with age 89. This remains a possible memorial comparison, not an identification. The cited Findagrave account and churchyard category associate him with Symington Churchyard, whereas the new transcript names St Johns Kirk, Biggar. The monument wording or image is needed to determine whether these describe the same man, different commemorations or different people. The transcript names no spouse or other relative. No cemetery, date or family field is changed.
